statement: The original D,L,FamP, ParameterChoice, SizesAt, fills, support, GatTies, LatCmp and lattice records remain the actual supplied objects. No independently selected family is substituted.

The full original AdmFam/admitted record, including admG1 and its additional clauses, is retained whenever quantified. GLG7/9 prove the complete original nested counting endpoints under that exact original antecedent; they do not construct an admitted family.
Actual ValRat or GroupCompatibilityFamily, including CmpTied, is retained. GLG14 supplies its complete rational-descent consumer. Existence of that comparison package is not inferred.
The exact eventual MeanKappaBound on the same X and K is retained in GLG18. GW2 can discharge it only with its recorded canonical-deficit and coefficient bounds; nonnegative K alone is insufficient.

Finite-dimensional linear algebra, basis extension, polynomial coefficients, elementary divisors over DVRs, torsion-free flatness over a DVR, finite tensor exactness, geometric series and elementary real limits. Their relevant finite consumers and normalizations are proved explicitly here.
